arxiv-2202-03985.title: A Model of Virus Infection with Immune Responses Supports Boosting CTL Response to Balance Antibody Response
arxiv-2202-03985.creator: Tyler Meadows, Elissa J. Schwartz
arxiv-2202-03985.description: Abstract We analyze a within-host model of virus infection with antibody and CD 8 + 8^{+} cytotoxic T lymphocyte (CTL) responses proposed by Schwartz et al. (2013). The goal of this work is to gain an overview of the stability of the biologically-relevant equilibria as a function of the model’s immune response parameters.

arxiv-2303-00063.title: New chondritic bodies identified in eight oxygen-bearing white dwarfs
arxiv-2303-00063.creator: Alexandra E. Doyle, Beth L. Klein, Patrick Dufour, Carl Melis, B. Zuckerman, Siyi Xu, Alycia J. Weinberger, Isabella L. Trierweiler, Nathaniel N. Monson, Michael A. Jura ∗, Edward D. Young
arxiv-2303-00063.description: Abstract We present observations and analyses of eight white dwarf stars that have accreted rocky material from their surrounding planetary systems. The spectra of these helium-atmosphere white dwarfs contain detectable optical lines of all four major rock-forming elements (O, Mg, Si, Fe). This work increases the sample of oxygen-bearing white dwarfs with parent body composition analyses by roughly thirty-three percent.

arxiv-2410-10050.title: XAI-based Feature Selection for Improved Network Intrusion Detection Systems
arxiv-2410-10050.creator: Osvaldo Arreche e1,addr1, Tanish Guntur e2,addr2, Mustafa Abdallah e3,addr3
arxiv-2410-10050.description: Abstract Explainability and evaluation of AI models are crucial parts of the security of modern intrusion detection systems (IDS) in the network security field, yet they are lacking. Accordingly, feature selection is essential for such parts in IDS because it identifies the most paramount features, enhancing attack detection and its description.

arxiv-2510-09718.title: Federated k -Means via Generalized Total Variation Minimization
arxiv-2510-09718.creator: Alexander Jung
arxiv-2510-09718.description: Abstract We consider the problem of federated clustering, where inter-connected devices have access to private local datasets and need to jointly cluster the overall dataset without sharing their local dataset. Our focus is on hard clustering based on the k k -means principle. We formulate federated k k -means clustering as an instance of GTVMin.

pmc-10560747.title: Global trade network patterns are coupled to fisheries sustainability
pmc-10560747.creator: Laura G Elsler, Maartje Oostdijk, Jessica A Gephart, Christopher M Free, Junfu Zhao, Eden Tekwa, Elaine M Bochniewicz, Alfredo Giron-Nava, Andrew F Johnson
pmc-10560747.description: The rapid development of seafood trade networks alongside the decline in biomass of many marine populations raises important questions about the role of global trade in fisheries sustainability. Mounting empirical and theoretical evidence shows the importance of trade development on commercially exploited species.

pmc-10650499.title: A Metabolomics Study of Feces Revealed That a Disturbance of Selenium-Centered Metabolic Bioprocess Was Involved in Kashin–Beck Disease, an Osteoarthropathy Endemic to China
pmc-10650499.creator: Yan Wen, Bingyi Wang, Panxing Shi, Xiaoge Chu, Sirong Shi, Yao Yao, Lu Zhang, Feng Zhang
pmc-10650499.description: Background: Kashin–Beck disease (KBD) is a distinct osteoarthropathy in China with an unclear pathogenesis. This study aims to explore whether perturbations in the intestine metabolome could be linked to KBD individuals. Methods: An investigation was conducted in KBD endemic villages and fecal samples were collected.

pmc-11364168.title: splicekit: an integrative toolkit for splicing analysis from short-read RNA-seq
pmc-11364168.creator: Gregor Rot, Arne Wehling, Roland Schmucki, Nikolaos Berntenis, Jitao David Zhang, Martin Ebeling
pmc-11364168.description: MotivationAnalysis of alternative splicing using short-read RNA-seq data is a complex process that involves several steps: alignment of reads to the reference genome, identification of alternatively spliced features, motif discovery, analysis of RNA-protein binding near donor and acceptor splice sites, and exploratory data visualization.

pmc-11471707.title: Adverse Childhood Experiences and HIV-Related Stigma: A Quantitative Survey of Tanzanian Men, June 2019
pmc-11471707.creator: Amandeep Kaur, Monique J Brown, Geoffrey K Kangogo, Xiaoming Li, Ivan E Teri, Gaspar Mbita, Aima A Ahonkhai, BRIDGE Africa Team, Donaldson F Conserve
pmc-11471707.description: Experiencing adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) may impact personal opinions, attitudes, and judgments, which can further result in HIV-related stigma. HIV-related stigma consequentially may impact HIV preventive measures such as HIV testing, pre-exposure prophylaxis uptake, and condom use. The extent to which ACEs influence HIV-related stigma perception has not been well studied.

pmc-11645319.title: New Properties of Holomorphic Sobolev–Hardy Spaces
pmc-11645319.creator: William Gryc, Loredana Lanzani, Jue Xiong, Yuan Zhang
pmc-11645319.description: We give new characterizations of the optimal data space for the Lp(bD,σ)-Neumann boundary value problem for the ∂¯ operator associated to a bounded, Lipschitz domain D⊂C. We show that the solution space is embedded (as a Banach space) in the Dirichlet space and that for p=2, the solution space is a reproducing kernel Hilbert space.

pmc-13066716.creator: Md Mahmudul Hasan, Eftekhar Alam Bhuyan, Md Ekramul Haque Ekram, Nawreen Monir Proma, Mohammed Kamrul Hossain
pmc-13066716.description: Baccaurea motleyana (Rambai) is traditionally consumed in Southeast Asia and used ethnomedicinally, yet its toxicological profile remains unclear. This study evaluated the acute and subacute oral toxicity of its aqueous fruit extract (AE‐BMF) in Wistar rats. AE‐BMF was prepared from fresh pulp.

pmc-13565093.title: Integrated Analysis of Species Invasion Under the Telecoupling Framework: Burmese Python Across Southeast Asia, the USA, and Beyond
pmc-13565093.creator: Camille Klemann, Jianguo Liu
pmc-13565093.description: Simple SummaryAs the world becomes more connected through trade and travel, more plants and animals become invasive species beyond their native habitats. Burmese pythons are a good example of this. Native to Southeast Asia, they were brought to America as pets and later established themselves as an invasive species in southern Florida, where they have caused major ecological impacts.
